description: This file provides repository functions for managing 'Run' and 'Attempt' entities in a database, including creation, retrieval, updating statuses, and linking assets and notifications. It encapsulates database operations for a certification backend system, utilizing SQLAlchemy ORM and custom data schemas.

classes.name: Run
classes.description: ORM model representing a certification run, including attributes like run_id, correlation_key, status, attempts, assets, etc.

classes.name: Attempt
classes.description: ORM model representing an individual attempt within a run, with attributes like attempt_id, run_id, status, assets, etc.

classes.name: Asset
classes.description: ORM model for assets linked to attempts, containing details like name, path, content type, size, and attempt association.

classes.name: NotificationSetting
classes.description: ORM model for notification configurations related to runs, including notification URLs and emails.

methods.name: AssetRef _to_asset_ref(a: Asset)
methods.description: Converts an Asset ORM object to an AssetRef schema.

methods.name: AttemptStatus _to_attempt_status(a: Attempt)
methods.description: Transforms an Attempt ORM object into an AttemptStatus schema for external use.

methods.name: str _aggregate_run_status_from_attempts(attempts: List[Attempt])
methods.description: Determines the overall status of a run based on its attempts' statuses.

methods.name: RunStatus _to_run_status(r: Run)
methods.description: Converts a Run ORM object into a RunStatus schema, including attempts and assets.
